defects.description: PR-v2 set shoulderFwdL=35, shoulderFwdR=30 using the INVERTED (old) sign convention (claimed + = forward). Per CORRECTED convention + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD. Description says Rest both FOREARMS FLAT on top rail — arms reach forward toward fence. Currently shoulderFwdL=35 puts upper arm BEHIND body (elbow z=-0.094). Forearms then bend forward — anatomically awkward reverse-reach. Should be NEGATIVE (forward).

PR-v2 set hipAbductR=-12 using inverted convention (claimed + = spread). Per CORRECTED convention + = ADDUCTION (inward/cross), - = ABDUCTION (outward/spread). Description says Cross one foot BEHIND the other — crossing foot moves INWARD (adduct, positive). PR-v2 made right leg abduct outward — opposite of crossing. Original +10 was closer (but still needs rightHip negative to swing leg back for cross-behind).

regression_risk: low — single-pose 4-field change; reverses PR-v2 sign errors that used inverted convention. Re-render verification recommended.
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: shoulderFwd + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD. hipAbduct + = adduction(inward/cross), - = abduction(outward). rightHip + = forward, - = BACKWARD. Description: Rest both forearms flat on top rail, cross one foot BEHIND the other. (1) shoulderFwdL 35 → -35, shoulderFwdR 30 → -30: flip sign so upper arms reach FORWARD toward fence rail (elbow moves to z+). (2) hipAbductR -12 → +12: adduct right leg INWARD (crossing). (3) rightHip 0 → -12: right leg swings BACKWARD (foot crosses BEHIND left). PR-v2 used inverted sign convention for both shoulderFwd and hipAbduct — both fixes were wrong-direction. Keeping spine=28 (forward lean ✓), leftShoulder=-55/rightShoulder=-50 (arms at 73°/67° abduction, chest-height ✓), leftElbow=95/rightElbow=95 (right-angle forearm flat on rail ✓).
